title: A bis-phenolate for the construction of linear lanthanide trimers

synthesis.procedure: LH4 (200 mg, 0.536 mmol) and Gd(NO3)3·6H2O (484 mg, 1.072 mmol) were dissolved in a 1:1 v/v MeOH/DMF mixture. After stirring for 10 min, Et3N (0.3 mL) was added and stirring was continued for a further hour. After filtration, crystals of 1 were grown by diffusion of MeCN. The main text only states that Ln(NO3)3·6H2O and LH4 were combined in DMF–MeOH with triethylamine and crystallised by acetonitrile vapour diffusion.
synthesis.time: 10 min, then 1 h after Et3N addition
synthesis.vessel_or_method: stirring in 1:1 v/v MeOH/DMF, filtration, then MeCN diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtration followed by diffusion of MeCN to give colourless crystals

properties.summary: DC susceptibility (5–300 K, 0.1 T) shows a room-temperature χMT value close to three non-interacting Gd(III) ions and a decrease below about 100 K. A nearest-neighbour isotropic fit gives very weak antiferromagnetic Gd–Gd exchange (g fixed at 2); the same parameters fit the magnetisation data. The SI energy spectrum has an S = 1/2 ground state with a dense band of low-lying states.

measurements.name: J_Gd-Gd
measurements.conditions: nearest-neighbour isotropic spin Hamiltonian, g fixed at 2; fit of χMT and M vs H

material_class.structural_family: linear phenolate-bridged Ln3 trimer, isostructural with 1

synthesis.procedure: Prepared in an analogous manner to 1, using Tb(NO3)3·6H2O in place of Gd(NO3)3·6H2O. The shared procedure dissolves LH4 (200 mg, 0.536 mmol) and the lanthanide nitrate in 1:1 v/v MeOH/DMF, stirs for 10 min, adds Et3N (0.3 mL), stirs for a further hour, filters, and grows crystals by MeCN diffusion. No separate numerical amount is given for the terbium salt.
synthesis.time: 10 min, then 1 h after Et3N addition
synthesis.vessel_or_method: stirring in 1:1 v/v MeOH/DMF, filtration, then MeCN diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtration followed by diffusion of MeCN

properties.summary: χMT at 300 K is close to three non-interacting Tb(III) ions and falls on cooling below about 100 K, consistent with ligand-field depopulation and/or very weak antiferromagnetic exchange. AC susceptibility below 10 K (frequencies up to 1000 Hz) shows no out-of-phase signal.

measurements.conditions: below 10 K, frequencies up to 1000 Hz; no out-of-phase signal

properties.summary: χMT at 300 K matches three non-interacting Dy(III) ions, reaches a minimum near 20 K, then rises to 5 K, indicating very weak ferromagnetic nearest-neighbour exchange. Frequency-dependent out-of-phase AC signals below 6 K indicate the onset of slow magnetisation relaxation and SMM behaviour.
